Definition: Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess
BiblicalUsage: Gomer is the name of a son of Japheth, the ancestor of a people, and also the name of Hosea's unfaithful wife. In Genesis 10:2, the text says "The sons of Japheth; Gomer." The life behind the name is told on the Gomer People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gomer matters because God knows His people by name, and Gomer is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
